neighbours.label: The preposition or place word right after a verb of starting ('start with', 'starting near', 'begin at', 'beginnt mit'): where or with what something begins
fire: Not sure where to begin? Why not start with the easiest chapter first.
The walking tour starts at the old harbour and ends near the cathedral.
Beginning near the visitor centre, the trail climbs steadily for two miles.
I always begin with a rough sketch before adding any colour.
The parade will start from the town hall at ten o'clock sharp.
Let's start in the top right corner of the spreadsheet and work down.
The company began with a single bakery in a small village.
Der Rundgang beginnt mit einem Besuch im alten Rathaus.
quiet: Not sure what to read? Why not finish with the easiest chapter first.
The walking tour passes the old harbour and ends near the cathedral.
Located near the visitor centre, the trail climbs steadily for two miles.
I always work with a rough sketch before adding any colour.
The parade will pass the town hall at ten o'clock sharp.
Let's look in the top right corner of the spreadsheet for the total.
The company dealt with a single bakery in a small village.
Der Rundgang endet mit einem Besuch im alten Rathaus.
